In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Polyhedron170">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> a pair of '''Lutki''' negotiated to buy several [[Roonstone]]s from [[Mungo Baobab]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]].<ref name="AtRS">{{DroidsCite|Across the Roon Sea}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Master Mungo, the Lutki have just made what I consider to be a very reasonable offer for the Roonstones.|C-3PO|<ref name="AtRS" />}}
In the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] episode "[[Across the Roon Sea]]," Mungo Baobab meets with two aliens of apparently different [[Species/Legends|species]] to negotiate the sale of a number of Roonstones. Baobab's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] uses the word "Lutki" to refer to the pair but the exact meaning is unclear.
